name: macro-regime-platform-root
author: Arnav Agarwal
description: Root orchestrator for Macro Regime Detection Platform monorepo

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix frontend && echo "=== Next: Activate your Python virtual environment and run: pip install -r backend/requirements.txt ==="
scripts.dev: npx concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" --names "backend,frontend" -c "magenta,cyan"
